rationale: Motor vehicle collision with property damage (totaled car) and bodily injury to the policyholder.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan rear-ended on Route 9 at a red light by an unbraked vehicle at approximately 35 mph. Policyholder's vehicle is totaled with severe trunk/rear-end damage. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information. High priority due to vehicle total loss and injury.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.injury_party: policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance on report

rationale: Tree from policyholder's own property fell on a parked vehicle, causing direct damage to the hood and windshield — this is a covered comprehensive auto loss, not property damage to structures.
claim_summary: Riley Kim's maple tree fell in wind and struck parked vehicle in driveway, damaging hood and windshield. Comprehensive auto loss on active policy POL-1005; medium severity, $1,000 deductible applies.

case_facts.description: maple tree from policyholder's property fell in wind and struck parked vehicle
